name: Spain: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Spain package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present on the European template v2.0, with a section for every population pathway in the plan, or the cover letter identifies where the protocol fully describes the process.
K2 recruitment material present in Spanish for every recruitment item, with its use explained in K1.
One Spanish L1 PIS/ICF per population, substudy or optional activity in population_sets whose trigger is true, each with the Annex VIIIA personal-data appendix inside it.
For every principal investigator: M1 CV (updated within two years) and M2 declaration of interest (updated within one year).
For every site: N1 site-suitability statement signed by the site director or delegate.
O1 insurance certificate (Annex VA) in Spanish listing every site and principal investigator.
Annex VB sponsor responsibility commitment.
Annex VI non-commercial commitment, with the Annex VA certificate within 30 calendar days.
Annex VII civil-liability certificate from the site or organisation representative.
P financial budget present (single budget or set of site budgets).
European compensation form, consistent with the budget.
S1 biological-sample information (Annex XIII or the same information with a clear reference).
No separate national data-protection document in Part II; the EU GDPR statement is in the CTIS Form.
Cover letter identifies the agreed assessing CEIm, which participates in CTIS work and confirmed availability on the proposed dates.
Proof of the AEMPS fee in the CTIS Form (or the signed non-commercial exemption declaration); the selected CEIm identified during fee payment.
Every participant- or representative-facing document, including recruitment material, is in Spanish.
Administrative documents are in Spanish or English; insurance documents are in Spanish.
Participant documents are blank and unsigned; N1 is signed by the site director or delegate; insurance certificates and commitments are executed; K1, M1, M2, P and S1 are not signed.
Translations for participants who need another language are arranged by the sponsor (not submitted to the CEIm).
Compensation amounts, payment route and proration identical in the budget, the compensation form (if used) and every participant document.
Insurance route and wording identical in O1/O2 and every participant document.
Every site has its own signed suitability form and appears on the applicable insurance document.
Sample types, storage, transfers, retention and future-use route identical in S1, the protocol, the laboratory manual and the participant documents.
Data flows, roles, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the Annex VIIIA appendices and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Spanish national requirements and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Spain is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document and correct country placement.

Unique, stable, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata and in the document, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Spain receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (EMA/263067/2023 revised rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly and unsearchably; author metadata removed; signatures never disclosed (N1 and insurance documents carry signatures).
CCI redaction only after both tests: not in the public domain, and disclosure would undermine a legitimate economic interest.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
Before site start (outside CTIS): favourable CEIm opinion, AEMPS authorisation, signed site contract and site activation in REec are planned.
